Hi Alex — answers inline below and proposed next steps.

1) Telemetry:
- What we collect: application-level telemetry is focused on usage patterns and errors (API latency, request/response sizes, feature usage). We do NOT collect raw PHI from customer payloads for telemetry purposes.
- Identifiers: by default our telemetry includes pseudonymous identifiers (hashed user/session ids) to correlate events; it does not store plain-text email addresses or PHI.
- Disable/opt-out: For Dedicated and Private deployments customers can disable telemetry collection or route telemetry to their own telemetry endpoint. For Hosted customers we offer an opt-out toggle for certain telemetry categories and additional controls via contract for enterprise deals.

2) Docs site & cookies:
- Public docs: we use a standard analytics cookie (Google Analytics) for page metrics; it does not contain PHI. We do not set cookies that include customer staff emails or PHI.
- If your policy requires zero third-party analytics, we can provide a cookie-free docs export or host a privacy-first docs instance as part of a Private deployment.

3) HIPAA / BAA:
- Redwood supports HIPAA via a BAA. For Dedicated/Private deployments this is supported as standard. For our hosted API we do execute BAAs for enterprise customers (requires contract addendum and some scoping conversation on data handling). Typical timeline from SOW/contract signatures to a signed BAA is 2-4 weeks depending on legal review.

Questionnaire turnaround & review:
- If your team assigns someone to fill the questionnaire, most customers return it within 3-7 business days. Our security team typically completes an initial review within 3 business days of receiving the completed form; deeper artefact requests (e.g., full SOC 2 report) will add time and require an NDA.
